body.intro:
Partial English Translation
The story / scenario elements of this game have been translated into English.
The menu / system elements remain in Japanese.

"Helena Mercenary Corps ~The Cuckolded Comrades~"
is a tactical RPG created with the theme of cuckoldry fetishism.
All the H scenes depict cuckoldry related expressions.

16 base CGs (not including pose arts / variations)

* Story
John is a boy who just recently starts working as a mercenary,
accepted by the Helena's Mercenary Army. Although this group
mainly consists of female fighters, they have made significant
achievements in the army's history.

One day the army undertakes a quest of beating a gang group.
They must not underestimate the gangs, otherwise members
of the army will be abducted, r*ped and corrupted one by one.

Will the army be able to defeat the gang group, without any sacrifices?

* System
Every single defeat in battle prompts H scene.
Multiple H scenes are prepared for each unit.
When a unit is defeated a certain number of times,
the given unit betray your army.

* Ending
Two endings: Good ending and Bad ending.
